Tile Repairs, Grouting & Flooring in Dubai

A cracked tile in the hallway, crumbling grout near a shower or an uneven transition at a shop entrance each needs a different brief. Tell ServiceBay which surface is affected, how large the area is and whether spare tiles or flooring pieces are available.

Key benefits

  • Replacement tiles matched before lifting
  • Smoother transitions at doorways
  • A clear reopening and cleaning schedule

Tile replacement, grout and transitions

For individual replacements, include the actual tile width and length, edge style, surface finish and a photo taken in daylight. Show where the damage sits in the overall pattern. A matching spare from the original batch can be particularly valuable on a prominent wall or a continuous floor.

Work you can request

  • Individual tile replacement
  • Regrouting
  • Threshold and trim repairs
  • Floor preparation enquiries

Most common problems

  • A tile lifts at an edge
  • Grout crumbles around a shower
  • A doorway has an uneven transition

A loose tile at an entrance?

Flag the affected area for building staff and share a photo showing the surrounding route. Dispatch can discuss access and timing around foot traffic.

Why the base is checked before retiling

A recurring crack or moving edge can point to a problem beneath the finish. Looking at the base before selecting a replacement helps avoid repeating the same surface repair.

Common component failures & expert repair solutions

ComponentWhat you may noticeHow we address it
Grout jointGrout crumbles in one area.Check for movement before renewing the joint.
Tile beddingA tile rocks underfoot.Lift the loose piece, assess the base and rebed a matching tile.
Threshold trimA raised edge catches at a doorway.Replace the trim to suit the height change and door clearance.
Skirting bondA skirting tile pulls away.Prepare the base, rebond the piece and refinish its joints.

Before & after service

Before the visit

Mark loose pieces, cracked joints and height changes. Compare spare tiles against the existing floor in daylight.

At handover

Review alignment, joint finish and transitions. Confirm when the repaired area may be walked on and cleaned.

Work by property type

Residential

In an apartment, ask about permitted noise times and waste routes for lifting tiles. In a villa, identify any continuous patterns through connecting rooms. If only a few tiles will change, discuss where a visible shade difference would be least noticeable.

Commercial

In a shop or office, show the foot traffic route and which entrances must remain usable. Agree whether the work can be phased and when the area can reopen under the selected adhesive and grout specifications.

Industrial

For warehouse offices or staff washrooms, identify traffic and cleaning routines. Forklift routes, heavily loaded storage bays and specialist floor coatings need their own specification. Clarify which areas form part of an ordinary tiling request.

Tile batches, grout & trims

Send the box label, batch or shade code, tile thickness and photos of nearby pieces. For vinyl or plank floors, include the product range and joint profile.

How to plan the repair

Send the finish, damaged area and access hours. The inspection checks the base, the replacement material and adjoining levels. Agree the repair, curing time and reopening date before work begins.

How to compare flooring quotes

Measure each room separately and identify cuts, trims and thresholds. Check that the quote distinguishes measured area from the quantity of material ordered, which may include an allowance for cuts or breakage. Removal and substrate preparation can change the price independently of the tile selected.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions about Tile & flooring

Can you replace one tile when I have a spare?

Send the spare tile size and a photo beside the existing surface. Access, surrounding grout and the condition under the damaged tile will influence the final scope.

Will new grout match the old colour?

Age and cleaning can change the existing shade. Compare a sample in the actual room and agree whether a larger joint area should be renewed for consistency.

Does regrouting fix a leak?

Grout repair and leak investigation are separate jobs. Report any dampness in an adjacent room or the unit below so the source can be assessed before choosing the finish repair.

Can our shop remain open during floor repairs?

Share the entrance layout and peak hours. The team can review phasing, safe separation and material curing times before confirming an access plan.

How much spare material should I buy?

Ask for a quantity based on the measured layout, tile dimensions, pattern and cuts. Keep a labelled spare after handover if future matching matters.
